votes.quote: The tests replace real time with an injected clock and fake timers (`now: () => time, setTimer: (fn, ms) => {... timers.set(id, { at: time + ms, fn }) ...}`), so no test actually waits. They pin VIP ordering with `[2, 4, 1, 3]`. They pin the 10-second duration: after `advance(9_999)` nothing is complete, and after `advance(1)` order 2 is. They check that removing a bot puts the order back in place: `removing newest busy bot cancels cooking and restores original queue position` expects `[4, 1, 3]`. scripts/test.sh runs `npm test`, which runs `node --test`.
